title: A vision for global privacy bridges: Technical and legal measures for international data markets
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally concerned with the ethics of personal data management. It addresses the conflict between the human right to privacy and economic efficiency, proposing a new, ethically-grounded market model built on principles of transparency, accountability, and user control. The authors state that the current market players operate 'at the edge of what is ethically sustainable'. This represents a significant evaluation of the moral and ethical dimensions of international data markets.
